$comment: Known, accepted npm audit advisories at high/critical severity.
Checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs, which FAILS CI on any high/critical
advisory NOT listed here — so new vulnerabilities break the build while
Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date. Entries that no longer
match anything are reported as stale so they get deleted rather than
silently widening the exception over time.
All current entries trace to expo@54's build toolchain and were accepted
in Phase 2: clearing them requires expo 54 -> 57, a three-major React
Native migration that is its own piece of work.

allow.reason: Denial of service in the ICNS parser. Reached only via @expo/cli/metro at BUILD time, parsing our own app icons on a trusted machine — never at runtime and never on attacker-supplied input. Fix requires expo@57.
Denial of service in the JXL/HEIF parsers. Same build-time-only exposure as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr. Fix requires expo@57.

Arbitrary file read via a crafted stylesheet. postcss is pulled in by the Metro bundler at BUILD time and processes only our own source; the server ships no postcss and the app bundle contains no postcss runtime. Fix requires expo@57.
Path traversal in source-map auto-loading. Same build-time-only exposure as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q. Fix requires expo@57.
